text: OpenUI Studio 是一款面向 DSH Web 对话的交互式界面插件。它通过 /openui 命令让当前会话调用所选模型生成 OpenUI Lang，并在生成结果通过解析和完整性检查后保存为工具结果，显示在原生对话尾部。用户可以查看交互式卡片、图表和表单，并通过答案中的后续问题按钮把建议内容填入 DSH 输入框；还可重播答案的绘制动画。适合希望把回答呈现为可视化或可交互界面的 DSH 用户。它沿用当前会话或默认模型设置，需先在 DSH 中配置模型。

OpenUI Studio adds interactive answers to DSH Web chats. Use /openui with a question to generate OpenUI Lang through the configured model; valid results render in the native chat. Users can view cards, charts, and forms and add suggested follow-ups to the composer.
想让 DSH 把回答做成可以交互的卡片和图表。
能不能在聊天里输入一个命令，生成可视化界面？
I want DSH to turn an answer into an interactive UI in the conversation.
OpenUI Studio 的功能「按需生成交互答案」：在 DSH 对话中输入 /openui 加问题，插件调用当前或配置的模型生成 OpenUI Lang，并在解析和完整性校验通过后作为工具结果返回。
OpenUI Studio 的功能「在原生对话中呈现答案」：模型生成的结果会显示在 DSH 对话回合尾部；界面中的后续问题操作会将建议文本填入 DSH 输入框，答案动画也可重播。
OpenUI Studio 使用当前或指定的 DSH 模型生成界面，问题文本会随模型请求发送到该模型提供方；需要先在 DSH 配置可用模型。
dsh-openui-studio 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 7 天；提交数 16；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-openui-studio README · OpenUI Studio for DeepSeek Harness：English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

OpenUI Studio adds an on-demand `/openui` command to a normal DeepSeek Harness
(DSH) conversation. It generates [OpenUI Lang](https://openui.com/) with the
selected model, validates the result against the official OpenUI chat library,
and renders it in the conversation with the official OpenUI Renderer. DSH still
owns the conversation, reasoning, history, tool records, and composer.

dsh-openui-studio README · Quick start：1. Have DSH installed and select a default model in **Settings → Models**.
2. In **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `dsh-openui-studio`. Fully
   quit and reopen DSH after installation or an update. You can also install
   directly from the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/zouyao-andy/dsh-openui-studio).
3. In a Standard or PTC conversation, enter a command such as:

```text
   /openui Explain KV cache memory usage with a chart and a worked example
   ```

dsh-openui-studio README · Quick start：Only an explicit `/openui` request enables OpenUI generation for that turn.
Ordinary messages stay in DSH's normal flow. Attachments are supported; an
attachment-only `/openui` request is also accepted.

dsh-openui-studio README · Quick start：The agent calls `openui_generate` with the relevant conversation context. A
valid result is saved as a DSH tool result and shown in the main chat. If the
first result fails OpenUI validation, the plugin makes one repair call. If it
still fails, DSH shows a tool error; no partial interface is saved. Reopening a
conversation renders its saved result without another model call.

dsh-openui-studio README · Quick start：For OpenUI source generation, the plugin follows the current DSH conversation's
model, output-token budget, and reasoning effort. If the model produces no usable text, the tool error reports
the stream's finish reason, chunk counts, and raw text length without logging
the model's content. The tool will not start another generation in the same
`/openui` turn. Send a new `/openui` request to retry after a failure.

dsh-openui-studio README · Quick start：Buttons in an OpenUI answer insert their suggested question into the DSH
composer and focus it. They never send a message automatically.

dsh-openui-studio README · Drawing and replay：New answers use the [Swarm Rebuild](https://github.com/JoelBastoneLopez/swarm-rebuild) engine to reconstruct the rendered answer
layer by layer. Its cursors draw frames, type text, place media, duplicate
repeated elements, adjust dimensions, and use alignment guides. The tour
scrolls through unfinished work, then returns directly to the live OpenUI answer.
The viewport follows the leading active work, slowing down in dense sections
and speeding up across sparse ones. The handoff waits until the conversation
reaches the answer's end, then briefly crossfades to the live page.
Playback starts with readable answer content; there is no cursor-only intro.

dsh-openui-studio README · Drawing and replay：Saved answers open immediately. Click the **replay** icon beside **OpenUI
Studio** to rebuild one without generating it again. Click the canvas or press
Escape to return to the interactive answer. Playback is skipped when reduced
motion is requested or a new answer finishes while DSH is in the background.
The drawing controls follow DSH's light or dark theme; switching themes during
playback returns to the live answer.

dsh-openui-studio README · Drawing and replay：The animation snapshots the already-rendered OpenUI DOM. It does not alter the
OpenUI Lang result or add records to the conversation.

dsh-openui-studio README · Render settings：Edit [`render.js`](./render.js) to customize the presentation layer. Use the
configuration icon beside **OpenUI Studio** to open it in DSH, or edit the file
directly. It exports one JavaScript object:

dsh-openui-studio README · Render settings：| Setting | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `showEditButton` | `true` | Show the icon that opens `render.js`. |
| `toolbar` | `['replay']` | Order or hide `replay`, `debug`, and `download-log`. |
| `animation.autoPlay` | `true` | Draw newly generated answers automatically. Manual replay remains available. |
| `animation.followScroll` | `true` | Follow the reconstruction down the conversation. When `false`, show the complete answer immediately. |
| `css` | Bundled stylesheet | Scoped CSS overrides for the OpenUI answer. |

dsh-openui-studio README · Render settings：The `css` string includes typography variables such as
`--openui-studio-font`, `--openui-studio-body-size`,
`--openui-studio-body-leading`, and `--openui-studio-heading-size`. Keep custom
selectors under `.openui-answer` or `.openui-native` so they do not affect DSH.
These settings change rendering and controls, not the LLM prompt or saved
answer. Fully quit and reopen DSH after editing `render.js`; no build or new
model call is needed. Invalid settings fall back to the bundled defaults and
show an error beside the answer title.

dsh-openui-studio README · Render settings：Model-call settings live separately in [`cordis.patch.yml`](./cordis.patch.yml):
`provider`, `model`, `maxTokens`, `temperature`, `reasoningEffort`,
`maxQuestionChars`, and `promptSuffix`. Leave the model and generation settings
`null` to use the current DSH conversation's request settings. When a session
has no token budget, the plugin reads the selected model's `defaultMaxTokens`;
if that is unavailable, it lets DSH choose. A non-null plugin value overrides
the corresponding session setting. `maxQuestionChars` limits the question sent
to the generator, and `promptSuffix` appends environment-specific instructions
to the generated official OpenUI prompt. The base prompt and validation schema
still come from the installed OpenUI package. Restart DSH after changing the
plugin configuration. A profile's `cordis.patch.yml` is applied after the
plugin bundle, so it can override these fields for that environment without
editing the plugin source. Interface controls follow the DSH locale; generated
answer text follows the question's language.

dsh-openui-studio README · Animation diagnostics：1. Set `toolbar: ['replay', 'debug', 'download-log']` in `render.js` and restart
   DSH.
2. Click the bug icon beside **OpenUI Studio** to replay while recording block,
   cursor, animation, scroll, and finish events.
3. When playback ends, click the download icon to save the JSON log.

The log contains timing and geometry, not answer text. No DevTools Console is
required. Debug and download buttons are hidden by the default toolbar.

dsh-openui-studio README · Development：To work from a local checkout with Node.js 20 or newer:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/zouyao-andy/dsh-openui-studio.git
cd dsh-openui-studio
npm ci
npm run build

Install that directory as a local bundle through DSH's plugin manager. The
local checkout and npm package use the same plugin ID, so remove an older
`@local/dsh-openui-studio` installation before adding this one.

```sh
npm test
npm run test:render
npm run build
```

dsh-openui-studio README · Development：`src/host/index.js` handles the command, gated tool, model call, and OpenUI
validation. `src/client/chat-answer.js` places saved results in the DSH turn.
`src/client/native-answer.js` uses the official Renderer and stylesheet.
`src/client/swarm-reveal.js` connects the answer to the adapted Swarm Rebuild
engine in `src/client/vendor/swarm-rebuild.js`. The previous drawing strategy
files remain for comparison but are not used.
`scripts/gen.mjs` generates the official OpenUI prompt and schema, and
`scripts/build.mjs` produces the Host `index.js` and Client `client.js`
bundles. Rebuild and restart DSH after changing plugin source code.

dsh-openui-studio README · Development：The plugin does not add its own conversation database, sidebar, composer, or
DSH mode. Earlier custom `Stack` answers are intentionally unsupported by this
official-renderer version.

dsh-openui-studio README · Community and license：Add the [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic to discover
other DSH plugins. For DSH feedback or bug reports, use the
[DeepSeek Harness Discussions](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions);
the [DSH Discord community](https://discord.gg/4MrtZUhpxg) is also available.
This plugin is released under the [MIT License](./LICENSE).
The drawing engine is adapted from [Swarm Rebuild](https://github.com/JoelBastoneLopez/swarm-rebuild)
at commit `601f6e2`, under its [MIT License](./src/client/vendor/SWARM_LICENSE).

dsh-openui-studio README · DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenUI Studio 插件：[English](./README.md) | 简体中文

OpenUI Studio 在普通 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）对话中增加按需使用的 `/openui`
指令。插件使用当前选中的模型生成 OpenUI Lang，按 OpenUI 官方聊天组件库校验，
再用官方 Renderer 将结果显示在原对话中。对话、思考过程、历史记录、工具记录和输入框
仍由 DSH 管理。
section: DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenUI Studio 插件

text:
dsh-openui-studio README · 快速开始：1. 安装 DSH，并在 **设置 → 模型** 中选好默认模型。
2. 打开 **设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，输入 `dsh-openui-studio`。安装或更新后需
   完全退出并重新打开 DSH；也可以从 [GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/zouyao-andy/dsh-openui-studio)
   直接安装。
3. 在标准模式或 PTC 模式的对话中输入，例如：

```text
   /openui 解释 KV Cache 的显存开销，并用图表和算例展示
   ```

只有明确使用 `/openui` 的这一轮才会启用 OpenUI 生成；普通消息继续走 DSH
原有流程。指令支持附件，也支持只附附件、不输入问题的用法。

Agent 会结合当前对话中的相关信息调用 `openui_generate`。有效结果作为 DSH
工具结果保存，并显示在聊天正文。如果第一次生成未通过 OpenUI 校验，插件会尝试
修复一次；仍然失败时由 DSH 展示工具错误，不保存不完整的界面。重新打开历史对话
只渲染已保存的结果，不会再次调用模型。

dsh-openui-studio README · 快速开始：插件生成 OpenUI 源码时沿用当前 DSH 会话的模型、输出 token 上限和推理强度。
如果模型没有产生可用文本，
工具错误会记录流的结束原因、各分片数量和原始文本长度，不记录模型内容。
同一轮 `/openui` 不会再次启动生成；失败后可重新发送一条 `/openui` 请求。

点击 OpenUI 回答中的交互选项，会把建议问题填入 DSH 输入框并将焦点移过去；
**不会自动发送消息**。

dsh-openui-studio README · 绘制动画与重播：新回答使用 [Swarm Rebuild](https://github.com/JoelBastoneLopez/swarm-rebuild) 引擎逐层重建已经渲染好的界面。多个光标会绘制边框、
输入文字、放置媒体、复制重复元素、调整尺寸，并显示对齐辅助线。巡航会跟随尚未
完成的区域向下滚动，结束后恢复可交互的 OpenUI 回答。
镜头跟随最靠前的活跃工作，任务密集处放慢、稀疏处加快；滚动到回答的实际末尾后，
绘制层通过短暂淡出交还真实页面。
播放时直接显示可读内容，不再先播放只有光标的开场。

历史回答会立即完整显示。点击 **OpenUI Studio** 旁的**重播**图标，可在不调用
模型的情况下重新播放绘制动画。点击画布或按 Escape 可直接返回可交互回答。
系统设置了减少动态效果，或新回答在 DSH 后台完成时，会跳过自动播放。
尺规与操作栏跟随 DSH 的深浅色主题；播放途中切换主题会直接显示真实回答。

动画从已渲染的 OpenUI DOM 获取快照，不修改 OpenUI Lang 结果，也不增加聊天记录。

dsh-openui-studio README · 渲染配置：编辑 [`render.js`](./render.js) 可以调整渲染层。点击 **OpenUI Studio** 旁的
配置图标可在 DSH 中打开它，也可以直接编辑文件。文件默认导出一个 JavaScript
对象：

| 参数 | 默认值 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `showEditButton` | `true` | 显示打开 `render.js` 的配置图标。 |
| `toolbar` | `['replay']` | 排列或隐藏 `replay`、`debug`、`download-log` 按钮。 |
| `animation.autoPlay` | `true` | 新回答自动播放；关闭后仍可手动重播。 |
| `animation.followScroll` | `true` | 随绘制位置滚动；关闭时直接显示完整回答。 |
| `css` | 插件内置样式 | 覆盖 OpenUI 回答区域的 CSS。 |

dsh-openui-studio README · 渲染配置：`css` 中提供 `--openui-studio-font`、`--openui-studio-body-size`、
`--openui-studio-body-leading`、`--openui-studio-heading-size` 等字体变量。
新增 CSS 选择器应限定在 `.openui-answer` 或 `.openui-native` 下，避免影响
DSH 自身界面。这些设置只改变渲染和按钮，不改变大模型提示词或已保存的回答。
修改 `render.js` 后需完全退出并重新打开 DSH；无需重新构建插件或调用模型。
配置无效时会回退到插件内置默认值，并在回答标题旁显示错误。

dsh-openui-studio README · 渲染配置：模型调用参数维护在 [`cordis.patch.yml`](./cordis.patch.yml)：`provider`、
`model`、`maxTokens`、`temperature`、`reasoningEffort`、`maxQuestionChars`
和 `promptSuffix`。模型与生成参数设为 `null` 时，优先使用当前 DSH 会话的请求
设置；会话未指定输出上限时读取所选模型的 `defaultMaxTokens`，再没有则交给
DSH 决定。插件中填入的非空值会覆盖对应会话设置。`maxQuestionChars` 限制传给
生成器的问题长度；`promptSuffix` 可按环境追加提示词。基础提示词和校验 Schema
仍来自已安装的 OpenUI 官方组件库。DSH 会在插件包配置之后应用当前 profile 的
`cordis.patch.yml`，因此不同环境可在各自 profile 中覆盖这些字段，无需修改插件
源码。修改配置后需重启 DSH。界面控件跟随 DSH 语言，生成内容跟随提问语言。

dsh-openui-studio README · 动画调试：1. 在 `render.js` 中设置 `toolbar: ['replay', 'debug', 'download-log']`，然后
   重启 DSH。
2. 点击 **OpenUI Studio** 旁的虫形图标，重播并记录内容块、光标、动画、滚动
   和结束事件。
3. 播放结束后点击下载图标，保存 JSON 日志。

日志只包含时间与几何信息，不包含回答正文；不需要打开开发者工具控制台。
默认工具栏只显示重播按钮，调试和下载按钮默认隐藏。

dsh-openui-studio README · 开发与验证：使用 Node.js 20 或更新版本从本地源码开发：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/zouyao-andy/dsh-openui-studio.git
cd dsh-openui-studio
npm ci
npm run build

然后通过 DSH 插件管理器将该目录安装为本地插件。新版与 npm 包使用相同插件 ID；
添加前请移除旧的 `@local/dsh-openui-studio` 安装。

```sh
npm test
npm run test:render
npm run build
```

dsh-openui-studio README · 开发与验证：`src/host/index.js` 负责指令、受控工具、模型调用和 OpenUI 校验；
`src/client/chat-answer.js` 把已保存结果放进 DSH 回答区；
`src/client/native-answer.js` 使用官方 Renderer 和样式。
`src/client/swarm-reveal.js` 将回答接入改造后的
`src/client/vendor/swarm-rebuild.js` 引擎。旧绘制策略文件保留供
对比，但新动画不再依赖它们。
`scripts/gen.mjs` 生成官方 OpenUI 提示词和 Schema，`scripts/build.mjs`
生成 Host 的 `index.js` 与 Client 的 `client.js`。修改插件源码后需要重新构建，
并重启 DSH。

插件不会另建对话数据库、侧边栏、输入框或 DSH 模式。这个基于官方 Renderer
的版本不兼容早期自定义 `Stack` 回答。

dsh-openui-studio README · 社区与许可证：可以通过 [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) 主题发现其他 DSH
插件。DSH 的反馈和问题请到
[DeepSeek Harness Discussions](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions)
提交，也可以加入 [DSH Discord 社区](https://discord.gg/4MrtZUhpxg)。
本插件采用 [MIT License](./LICENSE)。
绘制引擎改编自 [Swarm Rebuild](https://github.com/JoelBastoneLopez/swarm-rebuild)
的 `601f6e2` 提交，遵循其 [MIT License](./src/client/vendor/SWARM_LICENSE)。
